summary: EcoPowerHub.ai - IoT energy monitoring platform on ICP (Internet Computer). Uses a Motoko canister (equipa) to poll Shelly smart energy devices (shelly-1, shelly-em, shelly-live) via HTTP outcalls. A Node.js poller script (poll-devices.cjs) runs via cron every minute using the automation-plain dfx identity. Currently polling works when run manually with full dfx path, but cron still has duplicate entries. The equipa canister has a build error (missing HashMap import) and returns mock data with timestamp=0.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix equipa main.mo: add missing HashMap import and fix timestamp=0 by using Time.now()
In backend/main.mo (the equipa canister), add the missing import statement `import HashMap "mo:base/HashMap";` so the canister compiles without the 'unbound variable HashMap' error at line 47.

In backend/main.mo, fix all places where device records are constructed with `timestamp = 0` by replacing the hardcoded `0` with `Time.now()`. Add `import Time "mo:base/Time";` if not already present.
